stepUp.loosen: A looser rule needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.

cr6.title: Chromium VI evidence
cr6.description: What counts as evidence that a leather lot is under the chromium VI limit (Owner answer Q14).
cr6.question: What counts as chromium VI evidence?

option.LOT_REPORT_REQUIRED: A lab report for every lot

hint.SUPPLIER_REPORT_ACCEPTED: The supplier's report that covers the article and the period counts, as does a lab report on the lot. This is the default.
hint.LOT_REPORT_REQUIRED: Only a lab report on the lot itself counts. Lots that rest on a supplier report go back to quarantine checks.

source.TENANT: The rule of every company of the factory.
source.DEFAULT: The default rule: nobody has changed it.

cr6.loosens: This accepts more evidence than today
cr6.loosensBody: Applying asks why, then a fresh code from your authenticator app.
cr6.failed: The chromium VI rule could not be read.
cr6.limitLocked: locked: it is the law, not a setting
cr6.lawPlain: Leather articles that come into contact with the skin may not contain chromium VI at 3 mg/kg or more of the total dry weight of the leather.
cr6.materialsDescription: Read from each material (Cr VI test required); a brand's lower limit is the material's own.
cr6.materialsCount_one: {count} material needs a chromium VI test.
cr6.materialsCount_other: {count} materials need a chromium VI test.
cr6.noLowerLimits: No material sets a lower limit than the law.
cr6.materialsLink: Open Products › Materials & trims (Cr VI test)
cr6.materialsNoRight: The material list is not in your role (product.materials.view).
cr6.noOwnRow: This scope keeps no rule of its own: the rule above applies.

loosen.title: Confirm a looser rule
loosen.stepUpNote: Applying then asks for a fresh code from your authenticator app.
loosen.reasonHint: Kept with the change, for the audit.
loosen.offReasonHint: The question it waits for, in 3 to 500 characters.

code.BLOCK_REMOVED: From now on it no longer blocks: {gate}.
code.OVERRIDE_ROLE_ADDED: From now on the role {role} may grant a waiver.
code.OVERRIDE_LONGER: From now on a waiver may last {days} days (was {was}).
code.SWITCHED_OFF: From now on it is off: no gate checks it.
code.ARCHIVED: From now on it is archived: no gate checks it.
code.SCOPE_NARROWED: From now on it covers fewer styles or markets.
code.DATES_SHORTER: From now on it applies for a shorter time.
code.CHECK_CHANGED: From now on it is checked another way.

gates.title: Which requirement blocks what
gates.note: A padlock is the law: it never opens. The other cells are the company's choice.
gates.writeW1: Write the W1 certificate rule as a row
gates.builtInNote: The certificate rule of W1 is built in until the first refusal writes it as a row (or you write it now); until then it cannot change.
gates.failed: The gates could not be read.
gates.alwaysOn: Always on: the law locks it
gates.empty: Add the requirements the gates check: certificates, languages, labels, operators.

override.title: Waivers of {code}
override.subtitle: Who may let a refused step through, and for how long. Never at a padlock.
override.roles: Roles that may grant a waiver
override.note: A waiver always asks its reason and a fresh code, and is recorded on the work order or shipment.

add.suggested: The checks waiting for a row
add.suggestedNote: These checks are ready but do nothing until a requirement names them. They are added switched off; switch one on when the Owner says so.
add.noSuggestions: Every waiting check already has its requirement.
add.failed: The requirements could not be read.
add.offReasonHint: The question it waits for (3 to 500 characters), kept on each row.
add.checkHint: The check that computes it; none: the kind's own, or a person checks it.
add.switchHint: Switched on, it acts at the gates it blocks at once.
add.everyCompany: A requirement added here applies to every company.

changeKind.NEW_CITATION: New citation in the Official Journal

impactHint.NONE: The certificates stay as they are; the assessment is filed.
impactHint.REVIEW: Name the certificates the notified body must look at again: a type-change review opens on each style they cover.
impactHint.RETEST: Name the certificates that need new tests: a type-change review opens on each style they cover.

regs.title: Laws and standards in use
regs.note: Title, citation and link save as you type, one cell at a time.
regs.failed: The register could not be read.
regs.empty: Add the regulations and standards your certificates cite (Reg. (EU) 2016/425, EN 17092 …).
regs.editionHint: The year or edition: "2020". One row per edition.
regs.ojHint: The Official Journal reference, when cited.
regs.linkHint: An https address (EUR-Lex, the standards body).
regs.entryFailed: The entry could not be read.
regs.raisesChange_one: A change is raised naming the {count} certificate that cites it.
regs.raisesChange_other: A change is raised naming the {count} certificates that cite it.
regs.sourceHint: Where you read it: the Official Journal, NANDO, the standards body.
regs.deleteConfirm: Delete {label}? Only a row typed by mistake is deleted.

watch.title: Change watch
watch.note: When a standard a certificate uses is revised or withdrawn, assess it and open the impact task.
watch.failed: The change watch could not be read.
watch.emptyHint: A change is raised when an entry is marked superseded or withdrawn, or recorded from its window.
watch.changeFailed: The change could not be read.
watch.noStyles: No style is covered by the certificates it names.
watch.noCertificates: The change names no registered certificate.
watch.reviewNote: An open review holds the class label of the style's revision until it is decided.

matrix.title: What each market needs
matrix.description: Per market and language: the label (L), the declaration of conformity (D), the user information (U); under it, how many phrases print in each language.
matrix.label: Languages each market needs
matrix.empty: No market needs a language yet.
matrix.failed: The language matrix could not be read.

markets.title: Markets
markets.note: Cells save as you type; languages as codes ("de, fr").
markets.failed: The markets could not be read.
markets.empty: Add the destinations you sell to with their languages and marking.
markets.codeHint: Two capitals ("NL"), parts after a dash ("US-CA"). Fixed once saved.
markets.languagesHint: ISO 639 codes separated by commas: "nl, en".
markets.sellsHint: A market you add is on; off needs the question it waits for.
markets.offBody: Its own requirements wait while it is off; nothing is deleted.
markets.offReasonHint: The question it waits for, 3 to 500 characters.
markets.notFound: This market is not there (or not for you).
markets.extrasNote: Shown to people; a national rule is enforced at the gates by a requirement of this market.

phrases.title: Phrases & translations
phrases.note: One column per language a market that is on needs.
phrases.gate: Generated declarations and user information stay drafts until a PPE consultant says yes per template; translations come from this library only.
phrases.failed: The phrases could not be read.
phrases.empty: Add the label and warning phrases; their translations are approved by a second person.
phrases.keyHint: A key without spaces ("warning.class-b"). Fixed once saved.
phrases.phraseFailed: The phrase could not be read.
phrases.staleWarning: New words make the next revision: every approved translation is out of date until translated again.
phrases.staleNote: out of date: the source words changed
phrases.whoMay: A quality inspector who did not propose it

levelWhat.BRAND: Applies to the brand's private-label styles

operators.title: Economic operators
operators.note: Names and addresses exactly as labels and declarations print them; the most specific row wins.
operators.failed: The operators could not be read.
operators.empty: Without a row the maker is our company when it is in the EU; add importers and representatives where a market needs them.
operators.contactHint: An e-mail address is printed as the GPSR contact.
operators.validToHint: A last day ends the row; a row is never removed.
operators.notFound: This row is not there (or not for you).

field.title: Title
field.reviewCertificateIds: Certificates the notified body looks at again
field.name: Name
field.overrideRoleKeys: Roles that may grant a waiver

held.offline: Offline: changes wait until the connection is back.
held.crViManage: Only the owner changes this rule (quality.settings.manage).
held.requirementsManage: Your role may not change requirements (compliance.requirements.manage over every company).
held.rulesManage: Your role may not change rules and markets (compliance.rules.manage).
held.phrasesManage: Your role may not change phrases (compliance.phrases.manage).
held.phrasesApprove: Your role may not approve translations (compliance.phrases.approve).
held.ownWords: You proposed these words: a second person approves them.
held.locked: The law locks this gate: it keeps blocking.
held.lockedOn: The law locks this requirement at a gate: it stays on.
held.builtIn: Built in: write it as a row first.
held.code: A code of 1 to 60 characters, no spaces.
held.name: Give the name.
held.legalReference: Every rule says its law: give the legal reference.
held.edition: An edition of at most 40 characters.
held.title: Give the title (at most 300 characters).
held.noReviewForNone: No impact opens no review: untick the certificates.
held.reviewCertificates: Name at least one certificate for the notified body.
held.closed: Closed: it does not change any more.
held.noneAssessed: Choose assessed changes: only those close.
held.entryNamed: A certificate, a change or another entry names it: it stays.
held.marketCode: Two capitals ("NL"), parts after a dash ("US-CA").
held.languages: ISO 639 codes ("de", "fr"), each once, at most 20.
held.markings: Marks as codes of 2 to 20 capitals ("CE", "UKCA").
held.ruleKey: Each extra its own key without spaces.
held.ruleWords: Each extra in words (Italian or English).
held.phraseKey: A key of 1 to 100 characters, no spaces.
held.partyId: Choose the operator (only a manufacturer may be our company).
held.printedAddress: Give the postal address as printed.
held.validTo: The last day comes after the first.
held.stylesView: The styles are not in your role (product.styles.view).
held.partiesView: The parties are not in your role (parties.view).

problem.unavailable: The factory server did not answer. Try again in a moment.
problem.signedOut: Your session ended: sign in again.
problem.forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
problem.notFound: It is not there (or not for you).
problem.conflict: Someone changed it meanwhile: it was read again, check it and try again.
problem.rateLimited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on the server.
problem.cancelled: Nothing was done: the code was not given.
problem.taken: There is one already with this code (perhaps archived): open it instead.
problem.overlap: Another row for the same scope, market and role already covers these days: end it first or choose other days.
problem.locked: The law locks this: {field} stays as it is.

notice.crViLoosened: The looser chromium VI rule is in force.
notice.crViTightened: The chromium VI rule is saved.
notice.w1Written: The W1 certificate rule is now a row: it can be changed like the others.
notice.w1There: The W1 certificate rule was already a row.

saved.moveRaised_one: Status saved: a change was raised naming {count} certificate.
saved.moveRaised_other: Status saved: a change was raised naming {count} certificates.
saved.changeRecorded: The change is in the watch.
saved.assessedReviews: Assessment filed: the type-change reviews are open.
saved.taskOpened: Impact task opened with one item per style.
saved.proposed: Words proposed: a second person approves them.
saved.approved: Translation approved: it prints from now on.
saved.revised: New source words saved: approved translations are out of date.

refusal.LOCKED: The law locks this requirement at a gate: it is never switched off.
refusal.REASON_NEEDED: Say why it is off, in 3 to 500 characters.
refusal.DATABASE: The factory's rules refused this change as it is.
refusal.CLOSED: This change is closed: it never changes.
refusal.TASK_NAMED: This change has its impact task already.
refusal.NOT_ASSESSED: Assess the change before closing it.
refusal.NO_REVIEW_FOR_NONE: No impact opens no review: untick the certificates.
refusal.NOT_NAMED: A review is opened only for a certificate this change names.
refusal.NOT_DRAFT: Only a proposal waiting for approval can do this.
refusal.DRAFT_WAITING: Words are already waiting for approval in this language: change that proposal.
refusal.NOTHING_NEW: These are the words already approved.
refusal.SOURCE_LANGUAGE_TRANSLATED: The phrase is already translated into that language: it cannot become its source.
refusal.ARCHIVED: The phrase is archived: restore it first.
refusal.LANGUAGE: That is not a language code.
refusal.SOURCE_LANGUAGE: That is the language the phrase is written in.
refusal.STALE: The source words changed since this was proposed: propose it again.
refusal.OWN_PROPOSAL: You proposed these words: a second person approves them.
